title: Intersection of Polygons
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 3 \leq N \leq 50; 1 \leq M \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq Q \leq 2 \times 10^5; -10^8 \leq x_i, y_i \leq 10^8; -10^8 \leq u_i, v_i \leq 10^8; -10^8 \leq a_i, b_i \leq 10^8; All values in input are integers.; (x_1, y_1), (x_2, y_2), \ldots, (x_N, y_N) forms a convex N-gon in the counterclockwise order.; Each interior angle of the polygon P is less than 180 degrees.
